name: deal-desk
description: Structure deals, pricing, and proposals — pricing model selection, discount guidance, business case construction, and negotiation strategy. Use when structuring a deal, building a pricing proposal, negotiating, or creating a business case. Triggers on: "deal desk", "pricing", "proposal", "negotiation", "discount", "business case", "ROI case", "deal structure", or any pricing/financial request in a sales context.
